total intensity accumulated in double from float intensities, in order
stop examining maxima once explained intensity exceeds 0.5 * total (strict), at most five maxima
maximum search with strict >, starting from 0: the first highest point wins and nonpositive data yields no maximum
left shoulder: stops at data.begin() without examining it; intensity <= last, > 0, ratio to last strictly > 0.1, mz + 1 > max mz
rising point after the left shoulder restores the previous sink intensity
fewer than two left shoulder points (it_max - it < 3) marks break_left, but the right side is still cleared
right shoulder with mirrored conditions, mz - 1 < max mz; sink restore at line 130
float evidence ratio profile / float(profile + centroid); > 0.75 is PROFILE (the comment says 80%); 0/0 NaN is CENTROID
alternative quartile-of-distances estimateType kept inside a comment for reference (lines 158-242); never compiled, not ported
MSSpectrum::getType(true) calls estimateType(begin(), end()) after the stored type and the PEAK_PICKING history

evidence: Tier 1 (executed differential, oracle-generated): the unmodified product-sdk libOpenMS (Debug, core 4fdec46; git diff 4fdec46..bc9cc12 empty for PeakTypeEstimator.h, its class test and fixtures, MSSpectrum.cpp, DTAFile and MzMLHandler.cpp; installed PeakTypeEstimator.h equal to the pin) executed estimateType on the three class-test DTA spectra, on all 65 spectra of eight mzML fixtures and on eleven synthetic shapes. The Rust estimate_type matches every record whose peaks are finite, and MSSpectrum::get_type(true) with nothing stored equals the estimate on all 65 spectra; the reader-level getType(false)/getType(true) columns also match. The two non-finite synthetic shapes are refused natively and their C++ class (CENTROID) is asserted. Tier 3: the three PeakTypeEstimator_test.cpp sections are transcribed unchanged. Tier 4: ceiling parity with MSSpectrum::get_type_with_limits for a spectrum with no stored type and no data-processing records; the one work unit a default data-processing record costs get_type_with_limits (1 + 12 * bit length of its action count, charged before the peaks), which makes the 7-peak ascending_profile spectrum fail at max_work 224 where its peak slice is Profile, and both Profile at 225; and the finiteness refusal. The pte_ records are byte-identical to the previous oracle run; the 2026-09-14 amendment only added faims_ records. No Debug-only precondition lies on this path.
